generator_settings.flux_model: bundled EcoMug default parameterized cosmic-muon flux; horizontal normalization 129 Hz/m^2

geometry_crossing_definition: For each module separately, extrapolate InputFlux position and momentum to that module mid-plane (LOWER z=7.5 mm; UPPER z=105.9 mm) and test whether x and y lie within +/-16.5 mm. This is the 33x33 mm active-area footprint, not any individual bar-box intersection. Applied identically to LOWER/hod2018 and UPPER/hod2019.
